items.prompt: The white pawn on a2 is passed. Is it blockaded, that is, does an enemy piece (not a pawn) stand on the square directly in front of it?

claims.statement: White's passed pawns are a2 and b2.
White's blockaded passed pawns are none.

hints: Find the square directly in front of the pawn on a2.
Look at what stands on it.
A blockade needs an enemy piece there, not an empty square and not your own piece.
items.explain: The square in front of the passed pawn on a2, a3, is empty, so the pawn is not blockaded.

items.explain: The square in front of the passed pawn on c6, c5, holds a black bishop, which is not an enemy piece, so the pawn is not blockaded.
